avatar.name: The Overextended Newborn-Season Mother
avatar.description: First-time or early postpartum mother whose nights are ruled by a blocked nose: feeding stalls, sleep shatters, and every gurgle starts a private panic. She has tried the hospital bulb and maybe a mouth-suction tube; she feels mean when clearing, guilty when she fails, and exhausted when neither of them sleeps.
avatar.awareness_notes: Solution-aware on saline/bulb/steamy bathroom; product-aware enough to know NoseFrida/Braun exist; cynical about empty 'clears instantly' claims.

pain_points.description: Congestion sounds like the baby cannot breathe; she checks obsessively.

I keep checking his chest in the dark.

product_fit.mechanism: Nasal aspirator with a clear collection cup so mucus is visible when removed; designed to be cleaned without a sealed hidden chamber and without mouth contact.
product_fit.how_it_resolves: Turns blind guessing into a visible clear-out, reduces mould/mouth-suction failure modes, and shortens the night panic/feed loop.
product_fit.label: PLAUSIBLE_INFERENCE

held: Blocked nose blocks feed and sleep.

ready_to_shift: Default bulb/mouth tools fail for concrete design reasons.
A clear cup changes guessing into seeing.
